patch_description: Replace the fixed elite-versus-uniform parent choice with adaptive selection based on archive novelty, observed improvement, and under-exploration. Each parent’s attempts and cumulative relative score gains are tracked; parents that have produced useful improvements receive a modest productivity bonus, while rarely selected and structurally distinct archive members retain a chance to be explored. Update these statistics after each evaluated neighborhood. This makes parent selection responsive to actual LP results rather than relying only on rank or random selection.
